overview: The committee reviewed current enrollment data showing a return of students from private schools and received updates on labor negotiations and a new grant for English Learner teacher certification. The Superintendent also highlighted several student athletic and academic achievements.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, including bills, payrolls, and meeting minutes from October 17, 2022.

items.title: Superintendent's Update and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent recognized championship wins for the girls' soccer and middle school cross country teams and highlighted student awards in poetry and athletics. Upcoming events noted include a Thanksgiving football game at Fenway Park and Veterans Day activities.

items.title: Report on Labor Relations
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Murphy provided an update on the implementation of five settled bargaining agreements and noted that discussions with the Medford Teachers Association continue after their membership failed to ratify a tentative agreement.

items.title: EL Scholarship and Teacher Training Partnerships
items.summary: Director Teixeira announced a grant-funded partnership with UMass Boston to provide graduate-level coursework for teachers of English learners and an expanded secondary certification program with Lesley University.

items.title: District Enrollment Report
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Cushing reported a total district enrollment of 4,162 students, highlighting average class sizes of approximately 20 and an influx of students returning from charter and private schools. The committee discussed the impact of charter school enrollment caps and the high volume of English learner testing performed this year.
